_comment: Chapter addresses found by hand in a browser, by domain of shared/detection-rules.json. `url` is what check-sites.mjs fetches instead of guessing from the home page; `seen` is what the rendered page held that day (big = images at least 400x200, the detector's own floor); `note` is carried into the registry. Written 2026-09-18 from a PC whose network resets or blocks a number of these sites: `blocked` says the site could not be looked at from here, not that it is down. A domain that was removed from the rules on 18 September keeps its entry here as the record of why; a domain that moved is keyed by its new name, with the old name pointing at it.

mangapark.io.note: dead: parked, redirects to cf.waymart.site, which does not resolve (the same parking every expired scan domain shows today)

mangadex.org.note: blocked: the app bundle is cut by ERR_CONNECTION_RESET from this network; the reader is built in JavaScript (chapter pages are /chapter/<uuid>)

phenix-scans.com.note: dead: the domain now redirects to live.pushub.net (an ad network), which Kaspersky blocks; the team's site is elsewhere

olympusxyz.com.seen: 58 page images in the markup (media.imagesolymp.xyz, loading=lazy, 600 px column); that CDN does not answer from this network so none rendered
olympusxyz.com.note: chapter paths are /capitulo/<id>/<slug>: Spanish, not in the link patterns
